card.line: The Serpent's Stone was a rocky plateau near the spring En-rogel, where Adonijah held a feast to make himself king, though David had sworn Solomon would reign.

moments.title: Adonijah's feast
moments.text: Adonijah offered sheep, oxen, and fattened calves near the stone of Zoheleth, next to En-rogel. He invited his royal brothers and the men of Judah who served the king, but not Nathan, Benaiah, the mighty men, or Solomon.
